answer: Each identity locks a 25-unit bond in a shared vault and must publish a zero-knowledge uniqueness proof, keyed to the epoch beacon nonce, showing its cedar-rooted key appears exactly once among all registered agents, without revealing the key itself. A duplicate proof triggers an automatic 100% bond slash and ejects both copies. One proof costs 3 compute-hours and the beacon nonce rotates each epoch, so 100 fakes need 300 compute-hours and 2,500 bonded units every epoch, and any copy is caught by math, not by trust.
